# Service Terms

The service starts on January 1. The standard support window is Monday through Friday.

## Renewal

This agreement will not automatically renew.
Either party must provide written notice at least 30 calendar days before the renewal date.

## Contact

Send routine questions to the service desk.
Escalation: notify the on-call desk within 90 minutes.

cases.text:
# Records Policy

## Retention

The team must retain complete financial records for exactly 7 years.

## Legal hold

Records subject to a legal hold must not be deleted, even after the retention period ends.

## Disposal

A manager reviews ordinary disposal requests each quarter.
